reviews.text:
Thank you very much for taking the time to leave a review for Yodogawa Central Animal Hospital.

We are encouraged by your feedback and will continue to strive to provide reassuring medical care and guidance to both your beloved pets and you, their owners. Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns or questions.

We look forward to your continued patronage.
Despite it being a last-minute booking outside of their regular schedule, they were incredibly kind and helpful. I look forward to working with them again in the future.

The doctor was very kind, and when I explained that I have severe memory problems due to an accident, he wrote it down for me so I wouldn't forget. The receptionist also answered my questions very carefully. Most importantly, I was so happy that the doctor was so kind and gentle with my child. He also sent me a text message to remind me of the vaccination date and answered all my questions, even though he must have wanted to take a break as it was the last appointment of the morning. I would like to continue coming here regularly in the future (​◍​•​ᴗ​•​◍​)

Thank you very much for taking the time to leave a review for Yodogawa Central Animal Hospital.

We are extremely pleased that you gave our hospital a perfect 5-star rating.

We will continue to strive to provide careful medical care and support so that you can entrust your beloved family members to us with peace of mind.

Please feel free to contact us if you have any further questions or concerns.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

I had a truly unpleasant experience.

About two weeks ago, a young veterinarian here suggested we do a pre-operative examination for my dog's neutering surgery, so I came back today.

Because I had some concerns after the previous examination, I requested to see the head veterinarian this time. However, after waiting for over 40 minutes, the head veterinarian told me that "it's better not to proceed with the neutering surgery yet."

So what was the point of recommending the pre-operative examination two weeks ago?

Within the same hospital, different veterinarians give conflicting information, and despite coming in because the hospital recommended the pre-operative examination, this time the examination consisted almost entirely of taking my dog's temperature. And I was charged 1,980 yen for that.

It's not just a matter of money.

I'm entrusting this important family member's surgery to them, so the fact that different veterinarians have such differing opinions is extremely worrying.

I made time to come here and waited for over 40 minutes for this result; I simply cannot accept it.

Naturally, I canceled the pre-operative examination that was scheduled for next time.

I had been going to this hospital because I felt I could entrust my beloved pet's surgery to them with peace of mind, but this incident has made me lose all trust in them. I am extremely disappointed.

Thank you very much for taking the time to leave a review for Yodogawa Central Animal Hospital.

We are very pleased that you have given us such a high rating.

We will continue to strive to provide careful medical care and warm service so that your beloved family members can live with peace of mind.

Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions or concerns.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

I've been having my cat's claws trimmed here for years.
I can't trim her claws at home because she struggles so much, so I rely on the vet.
Even though my cat is very difficult and struggles to handle, they treat her kindly without showing any displeasure, and I'm truly grateful...
Every time I bring her in, they always talk to her, saying things like "Let's do our best," which puts me at ease.
I'm so thankful.
I'm so glad I found this vet.
Colon is 13 years old. I'm satisfied with the hospital's service.

I took my cat there for a second opinion because her condition had suddenly worsened.

I was physically and mentally exhausted from the daily hospital visits and nighttime emergency care, and my mind wasn't functioning properly. The head veterinarian, however, clearly outlined the treatment plan and, despite it being an emergency, managed to find time to see my cat.

My beloved cat has since passed away, but if I ever have another pet, I would want to continue taking care of them from vaccinations and checkups onwards.

Thank you so much.

I am grateful to have found Yodogawa Central Animal Hospital. I had a Shiba Inu for 17 years, and I was a "hospital refugee" after going to many different hospitals, but I started going to Yodogawa Central Animal Hospital four years ago, and I am grateful for everything from the reception and examinations to the aftercare. Most importantly, they explain my dog's pain and problems in an easy-to-understand way. My 4-year-old Shiba Inu is currently under their care, and I would like to continue receiving their care in the future. Thank you very much.
